clock-sleep.message: test-audit clock: wait on the event or drive a controlled clock, never a fixed sleep (docs/testing.md)

clock-elapsed.message: test-audit clock: assert work done (calls, renders, rows), never elapsed time (docs/testing.md)

snapshot-runloop-sample.message: test-audit snapshot: sample a per-frame check right after each display commit (sampleCommittedLayouts(in:), UIUpdateLink .afterCATransactionCommit), never from a run-loop observer (docs/testing.md)

snapshot-backup-cancel-confirmation.message: test-audit snapshot: await the confirmed Create Backup action before checking cancellation text or counting the request (docs/testing.md)

ready-report-layout.message: test-audit ready: use mountedReport for native report layout, and verify viewport movement before asserting teardown. Wait for the document only when reading its content (docs/testing.md)

ready-find-reader-bookmark.message: test-audit ready: move by a fraction of the viewport and wait for the reader to settle away from the latest message before recording a bookmark (docs/testing.md)

ready-gallery-notification-layout.message: test-audit ready: use an app-owned visible control to establish notification Settings layout readiness (docs/testing.md)

leak-report-webkit-ownership.message: test-audit leak: verify the App removed the report view and dropped its navigation and callbacks (docs/testing.md)

heavy-streaming-report-server.message: test-audit heavy: use a synthetic resolver to prove the streaming view never starts an HTML preview (docs/testing.md)

heavy-nested-report-files-picker.message: test-audit heavy: verify the report's original-file request and payload at the App boundary, and use the simulator workflow to check the nested system picker (docs/testing.md)

clock-day-seconds.message: test-audit clock: anchor a date days before now in calendar units (Calendar.date(byAdding: .day, ...)), never as seconds, which drift across a DST change (docs/testing.md)

unheld-clock.message: test-audit unheld: fake the whole clock (vi.useFakeTimers({ now })) so real timers cannot run behind the test (docs/testing.md)

retry.message: test-audit defect loop: fix the cause; a retry hides a flaky test (docs/testing.md)

retry-config.message: test-audit defect loop: fix the cause; a retry hides a flaky test (docs/testing.md)

hosted-handoff-screenshot-loop.message: test-audit heavy and oversized: test each focus handoff from its source posture and capture one screenshot per test (docs/testing.md)

hosted-layout-loop.message: test-audit oversized: put each hosted scenario that boots a new app fixture in its own test case (docs/testing.md)

leak-pasteboard.message: test-audit leak: never read or write the simulator-wide general pasteboard; record copies with recordCopies() and paste through the control's own seam, such as UIPasteControl.target.paste(itemProviders:) (docs/testing.md)

ready-send.message: test-audit ready: activate Send through activateSend(in:) or sendFromComposer, which wait until it reports enabled (docs/testing.md)

heavy-commit-draw.message: test-audit heavy: force a commit with commitDisplay(of:) (two display updates), never with a drawing no one keeps; the simulator's render server snapshots the whole window for every drawing (docs/testing.md)

heavy-pixel-draw.message: test-audit heavy: read a hosted window's pixels with committedWindowImage(_:scale:) or windowPixels(_:at:), which draw the committed frame; a drawing after screen updates makes the simulator's render server snapshot the window again and keep it (docs/testing.md)

cross-package-import.message: test-audit junk pattern: prove a server contract in the server's tests; feed the client a synthetic value typed by the contract (docs/testing.md)

ready-fresh-page-capture.message: test-audit ready: build a stand-in image from data (canvasImage in e2e/fixtures.ts), never by capturing a page the test just opened; a fresh page has no compositor surface yet (docs/testing.md)

leak-closing-release.message: test-audit leak: never release a held fixture run in a test's last lines; the app applies what it sends after the test returns, into the next test. Leave it held for teardown's fixture reset to end (docs/testing.md)
